verdicts.decision_note: The client requires the Heading 3 named style to retain its size while applying bold typography across the Word templates.
The freelancer raises a material unresolved question about whether Title and Heading 1 should share the same 24 pt size.
The client sets the rendered Title named style to 28 pt, resolving its required font size without leaving a conflicting prior title-size attribute.
The client's 28 pt decision resolves the preceding typography uncertainty and returns the Requirement to active implementation.
The client specifies the rendered image and table caption styles as 7/10 pt, italic, and Century Gothic, with no obsolete typography key requiring removal.
